nodes.text: But suspecting that they were prophesying to him not the truth but to flatter him, he writes to one Maternianus, who at that time had been entrusted by him with all business in Rome, and who seemed to be the most trustworthy of his friends and the only sharer in his secrets; and he orders him to seek out the best of the magicians and, by using necromancy, to learn about the end of his life, and
